- Image with ResNet50 gives only ~20.8% accuracy - very poor

- Single profile is the simplest setting, so testing a better encoder there isolates the encoder effect

I'll go with config_004 (scvi_n200, single profile, RNA only) to test if a learned encoder improves over PCA.
